subject: Milestone agreement & evaluation -> commit schedule
messages:
From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@ataraxia.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@ataraxia.ai>, procurement@ataraxia.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & evaluation plan — aligning ramp / commit targets

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to move from PoC to a short eval but procurement and our product team want a clear mutual action plan (MAP) that ties milestones to committed monthly tokens (TPM) and commercial terms. High level asks:

- Can you propose a 3-month evaluation->commit ramp with explicit TPM targets per month?
- Need pricing that maps to those milestones (discounts at tiered commit levels).
- Procurement needs a procurement-friendly timeline (PO window, DocuSign cadence).

I’ve attached a draft MAP (we labeled it v1) — please review and propose redlines to the ramp/discounts. Ideally we’d close commercial terms within 30 days of final MAP sign-off.

Julia
Product & Partnerships
Ataraxia, Inc.

Attachment: 20260629-ataraxia-map-v2.pdf

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@ataraxia.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — aligning ramp / commit targets

Julia —

Appreciate the clear ask and the MAP draft. I’ve sketched a proposal below that we think balances a low-friction eval with predictable economics for Ataraxia if you choose to convert to a committed plan. I’m attaching our pricing grid for reference.

Proposal (3-month MAP -> commit option):

1) Evaluation month (Month 0 / pilot):
   - Pilot cap: 25M tokens (no long-term commitment).
   - Goal: implement inference pipeline, baseline latency, and quality checks (we’ll run 3 prompt suites).

2) Ramp month 1 (Month 1):
   - Commit: 75M tokens / month.
   - Discount: 5% off list if committed at Month 1 start.

3) Ramp month 2 (Month 2):
   - Commit: 175M tokens / month.
   - Discount: 10% off list when commit >=150M TPM.

4) Ramp month 3 (Month 3):
   - Commit target: 300M tokens / month (full production).
   - Discount: 15% off list when commit >=300M TPM.

Overages billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates; credits applied at invoice when committed tier is reached for that invoice period.

Acceptance criteria / MAP milestones:
- M0: pilot data ingest + latency < 120ms p50 on your test suite.
- M1: successful integration + signed commitment PO for Month1.
- M2: stability (error rate <0.5%) and meeting 75% of expected throughput for two consecutive weeks.
- M3: production readiness and PO for committed tier.

Next steps: I’ll loop in Priyom (sales engineer) to confirm token measurement and runbook. Laura, can we authorize a one-time conversion credit for early sign (30-day close) if we need to sweeten the initial commit?

I’ve attached: redwood-pricing-grid-TPM-2026.csv and a redwood-sow-draft.docx.

Thanks — I’ll be available for a brief call tomorrow to walk through.

— Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Vega <c.vega@ataraxia.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@ataraxia.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — aligning ramp / commit targets

Michael / Julia —

Quick procurement notes:
- Our standard is a 60-day PO window once terms are agreed. Is Redwood able to accept a PO with a 60-day fulfillment/start window?
- Need clarity on how overages are defined vs. committed TPM (monthly measurement, timezone cutoff).
- Any SLA credits we can expect if production uptime targets are missed during Month 2/3?

Please send a one-page commercial summary we can attach to the PO.

Carlos
Head of Procurement, Ataraxia

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Vega <c.vega@ataraxia.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@ataraxia.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — aligning ramp / commit targets

Carlos —

A few clarifications to make procurement comfortable:

- TPM measurement: we measure tokens generated by the model per calendar month UTC. Overages are computed as (actual_tokens - committed_tokens) and billed at the overage rate on the next invoice. We can include a 7-day buffer for billing disputes in the SOW.

- PO start window: Redwood can accept a PO with a 60-day start, but the commit ramp and discount tiers will be tied to the invoice dates (not PO date). We will document expected start date in the DocuSign and SOW.

- SLA: For Month 2/3 we can offer a 99.5% availability target with a 5% service-credit for each 0.1% below the target up to a 20% cap, subject to a signed SLA appendix.

Alternative ramp (if Ataraxia would like a softer ramp):
   Month1: 50M TPM commit (5% discount)
   Month2: 125M TPM commit (8% discount)
   Month3: 225M TPM commit (12% discount)

We’ve also drafted a one-page commercial summary and attached the CSV pricing grid for line-item clarity.

— Priyom (SE)

Attachment: redwood-pricing-grid-TPM-2026.csv

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@ataraxia.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — aligning ramp / commit targets

Team —

If Ataraxia signs the MAP and returns a PO within 30 days of our final commercial summary, authorize a one-time 10% conversion credit applied to the first two invoices (not stackable with other promotional credits). Condition: single PO for the committed term and acceptance of the SLA appendix. Michael — confirm before you send to procurement that the credit is in the commercial summary.

Also make sure the MAP includes clear success gates (we can reuse the acceptance criteria Michael listed). Laura
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@ataraxia.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Carlos Vega <c.vega@ataraxia.ai>, procurement@ataraxia.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — aligning ramp / commit targets

Thanks everyone — the team reviewed the alternative ramp and the SLA language. We’re aligned on the softer ramp: Month1 50M, Month2 125M, Month3 225M. The 10% conversion credit is acceptable — procurement will prepare a PO once we receive the one-page commercial summary and the final MAP PDF.

I’ve attached the signed MAP v2 with our redlines (minor clarifications on acceptance criteria). Please send DocuSign for the SOW + SLA appendix and the commercial summary so we can route the PO this week.

Julia

Attachment: 20260629-ataraxia-map-v2.pdf (signed, redlines)
